entities.summary: Sarah Levy is an American rugby union and rugby sevens player. She plays the wing position in the fifteens, and plays the positions of hooker, winger, centre, or prop in the sevens. At the 2024 Paris Olympics, Levy competed in the women's rugby sevens tournament on the bronze medal–winning United States team.
